name: Saki
source:
The most captivating geisha in Kyoto, renowned for her elegance and allure. Behind her beauty is a sharp intellect and a wealth of cultural knowledge. With an information network stretching across Gion, she helps guide Masayoshi’s investigations from the shadows. 

[From [url=https://duskindexgion.bushiroadgames.com/en/#character]Official English website[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Take.[/spoiler]
